name: Privileged Communication with Identifiable Parties
description: Composite rule: triggers when BOTH a privilege/confidentiality marker AND a case caption or docket number appear in the same content. This combination conclusively identifies privileged attorney-client material that contains an identifiable matter. Per ABA Formal Opinion 512, this content must not be submitted to any AI system.

metadata.composite_logic: Triggers when privilege marker AND (case caption OR docket number) are both detected in the same content
metadata.compliance_notes: Per ABA Opinion 512: content with privilege markers combined with matter-identifying information must not be transmitted to AI. This rule is the hard gate — it does not transform, it flags for mandatory review.

effect.message: Matter identifier (case caption or docket number) detected
Content contains both privilege markers and matter-identifying information. Do not submit to any AI system per ABA Formal Opinion 512. Attorney review required before any transmission.
